mainEntity.name: Can I customize this olive rash guard for my brand or academy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Share your authorized logos, color direction, size allocation, labels and packaging requirements. TONTON will review the decoration method, material and physical sample route for your project.

mainEntity.name: What are the fabric composition and GSM?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied brief describes a four-way-stretch compression knit. Exact fiber percentages and fabric weight are confirmed against the selected swatch and approved specification; illustrative percentages and GSM ranges are not confirmed values for this reference.

mainEntity.name: Is the chest logo a raised silicone print?

acceptedAnswer.text: The chest artwork has a shadow-style appearance in the supplied images. Its physical height and decoration method require sample confirmation. Discuss the desired finish when sending your artwork.
Confirm a finished-garment chart and size grading for your target market. Check chest, waist, body length, sleeve opening and shoulder movement on representative fit samples.

mainEntity.name: Is this olive colorway competition approved?

acceptedAnswer.text: No universal competition approval is claimed. Check the current organizer and division requirements for colors, rank identification and garment fit before placing an event order.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum order and sample timing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selected TONTON custom projects start from 10 pieces, with a target sample window of 3–7 days after usable artwork and product details are confirmed. Final minimums and timing depend on materials, construction and quantities.

mainEntity.name: Does the video prove fit or performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The supplied video is a design presentation. Use a physical sample to approve fabric feel, fit, seams, print and wash care before bulk production.
